name: Tinyusb Keyboard → Media Press
description: Presses one media key, releasing any media key pressed before.

config_entries.label: Usage
config_entries.description: The HID consumer control usage id, for example `0xE9` Volume Up, `0xEA` Volume Down, `0xE2` Mute, `0xCD` Play/Pause, `0xB5` Next Track, `0xB6` Previous Track.
